# SENETECH Setup V1.5.0 - Windows 10 and 11 preparation assistant
# Test version: no disk erase, no Sysprep, no automatic reboot.

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

Add-Type -AssemblyName PresentationFramework
Add-Type -AssemblyName PresentationCore
Add-Type -AssemblyName WindowsBase

$script:EngineDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$script:Root = Split-Path -Parent $script:EngineDir
$script:ReportDir = Join-Path $script:Root 'Rapports'
$script:LogDir = Join-Path $script:Root 'Logs'
$script:OfflineDir = Join-Path $script:Root 'Hors-ligne'
$script:OfflineAppDir = Join-Path $script:OfflineDir 'Applications'
$script:OfflineDriverDir = Join-Path $script:OfflineDir 'Pilotes'
$script:LastReport = $null
$script:Hardware = $null
$script:AppResults = @()
$script:RebootRequired = $false
$script:OperationNotes = @()
$script:IsBusy = $false
$script:LastInternetState = $false
$script:AppVersion = '1.5.0.0'
$script:DisplayVersion = '1.5.0'
$script:UpdateManifestUrl = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iamdydy1/SENETECH-Setup/main/version.json'
$script:UpdaterUrl = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iamdydy1/SENETECH-Setup/main/UPDATE-SENETECH.ps1'
$script:InstalledRoot = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'SENETECH'
$script:InstallMarkerName = 'SENETECH-Install.json'
$script:InstallMarkerPath = Join-Path $script:Root $script:InstallMarkerName
try {
    $currentRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($script:Root).TrimEnd('\\')
    $installedRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($script:InstalledRoot).TrimEnd('\\')
    $script:IsInstalledMode = (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:InstallMarkerPath) -or $currentRootFull.Equals($installedRootFull, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
} catch {
    $script:IsInstalledMode = Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:InstallMarkerPath
}
$script:DeploymentMode = if ($script:IsInstalledMode) { 'INSTALLE' } else { 'PORTABLE' }

function Test-Administrator {
    $identity = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
    $principal = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($identity)
    return $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
}

if (-not (Test-Administrator)) {
    $selfPath = $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
    $selfArgs = "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$selfPath`""
    try {
        Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -Verb RunAs -ArgumentList $selfArgs | Out-Null
        exit 0
    } catch {
        [System.Windows.MessageBox]::Show('Les droits administrateur sont necessaires pour continuer.', 'SENETECH Setup') | Out-Null
        exit 1
    }
}


New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $script:ReportDir, $script:LogDir, $script:OfflineAppDir, $script:OfflineDriverDir | Out-Null
$script:SessionStamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$script:LogFile = Join-Path $script:LogDir "SENETECH-$script:SessionStamp.log"

function New-SenetechShortcut([string]$ShortcutPath, [string]$TargetPath, [string]$WorkingDirectory) {
    try {
        $parent = Split-Path -Parent $ShortcutPath
        if ($parent) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $parent | Out-Null }
        $shell = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell
        $shortcut = $shell.CreateShortcut($ShortcutPath)
        $shortcut.TargetPath = $TargetPath
        $shortcut.WorkingDirectory = $WorkingDirectory
        $shortcut.IconLocation = ('{0},0' -f $TargetPath)
        $shortcut.Description = 'SENETECH Setup'
        $shortcut.Save()
    } catch {
        throw ('Impossible de creer le raccourci SENETECH : {0}' -f $_.Exception.Message)
    }
}

function Write-SenetechUninstaller([string]$InstallRoot) {
    $uninstallerPath = Join-Path $InstallRoot '_SENETECH\Uninstall-SENETECH.ps1'
    $escapedRoot = $InstallRoot.Replace("'", "''")
    $scriptText = @"
`$ErrorActionPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
Add-Type -AssemblyName PresentationFramework
`$installRoot = '$escapedRoot'
`$answer = [System.Windows.MessageBox]::Show(
    'Voulez-vous desinstaller SENETECH Setup de ce PC ?',
    'SENETECH Setup',
    [System.Windows.MessageBoxButton]::YesNo,
    [System.Windows.MessageBoxImage]::Question)
if (`$answer -ne [System.Windows.MessageBoxResult]::Yes) { exit 0 }
`$startMenu = Join-Path `$env:ProgramData 'Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\SENETECH Setup.lnk'
`$desktop = Join-Path `$env:Public 'Desktop\SENETECH Setup.lnk'
Remove-Item -LiteralPath `$startMenu -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item -LiteralPath `$desktop -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\SENETECH Setup' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
`$cmd = 'ping 127.0.0.1 -n 3 >nul & rd /s /q "' + `$installRoot + '"'
Start-Process -FilePath 'cmd.exe' -ArgumentList '/c', `$cmd -WindowStyle Hidden
exit 0
"@
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($uninstallerPath, $scriptText, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($true)))
    return $uninstallerPath
}

function Register-SenetechInstalledApp([string]$InstallRoot) {
    $exePath = Join-Path $InstallRoot 'SENETECH-Setup.exe'
    $uninstallerPath = Write-SenetechUninstaller $InstallRoot
    $registryKey = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\SENETECH Setup'
    New-Item -Path $registryKey -Force | Out-Null
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $registryKey -Name 'DisplayName' -Value 'SENETECH Setup'
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $registryKey -Name 'DisplayVersion' -Value $script:DisplayVersion
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $registryKey -Name 'Publisher' -Value 'SENETECH'
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $registryKey -Name 'InstallLocation' -Value $InstallRoot
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $registryKey -Name 'DisplayIcon' -Value $exePath
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $registryKey -Name 'UninstallString' -Value ('powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "{0}"' -f $uninstallerPath)
    New-ItemProperty -Path $registryKey -Name 'NoModify' -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
    New-ItemProperty -Path $registryKey -Name 'NoRepair' -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

    $startMenuShortcut = Join-Path $env:ProgramData 'Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\SENETECH Setup.lnk'
    $desktopShortcut = Join-Path $env:Public 'Desktop\SENETECH Setup.lnk'
    New-SenetechShortcut $startMenuShortcut $exePath $InstallRoot
    New-SenetechShortcut $desktopShortcut $exePath $InstallRoot
}

function Install-SenetechOnThisPc([switch]$Silent) {
    if ($script:IsInstalledMode) {
        if (-not $Silent) {
            [System.Windows.MessageBox]::Show('SENETECH est deja installe sur ce PC.', 'SENETECH Setup') | Out-Null
        }
        return $script:Root
    }

    if (-not $Silent) {
        $answer = [System.Windows.MessageBox]::Show(
            "SENETECH va etre installe sur ce PC.`n`nEmplacement : $($script:InstalledRoot)`n`nUn raccourci sera cree sur le Bureau et dans le menu Demarrer. SENETECH apparaitra aussi dans Applications installees et continuera de recevoir les mises a jour depuis le meme GitHub.`n`nContinuer ?",
            'Installer SENETECH sur ce PC',
            [System.Windows.MessageBoxButton]::YesNo,
            [System.Windows.MessageBoxImage]::Question)
        if ($answer -ne [System.Windows.MessageBoxResult]::Yes) { return $null }
    }

    $destination = $script:InstalledRoot
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $destination | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $destination '_SENETECH') | Out-Null

    $runtimeFiles = @('SENETECH-Setup.exe','VERSION.txt','LISEZ-MOI.txt','CHANGELOG.txt')
    foreach ($name in $runtimeFiles) {
        $source = Join-Path $script:Root $name
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $source) {
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $source -Destination (Join-Path $destination $name) -Force
        }
    }

    $sourceEngine = Join-Path $script:Root '_SENETECH'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sourceEngine)) { throw 'Le moteur SENETECH est introuvable.' }
    Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $sourceEngine '*') -Destination (Join-Path $destination '_SENETECH') -Recurse -Force

    # Ne jamais copier les caches lourds de la cle vers Program Files.
    $installedDataDirs = @(
        (Join-Path $destination 'Hors-ligne\Applications'),
        (Join-Path $destination 'Hors-ligne\Pilotes'),
        (Join-Path $destination 'Rapports'),
        (Join-Path $destination 'Logs')
    )
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $installedDataDirs | Out-Null

    $marker = [ordered]@{
        product = 'SENETECH Setup'
        mode = 'installed'
        installLocation = $destination
        installedAt = (Get-Date).ToString('o')
        updateChannel = 'github'
    } | ConvertTo-Json
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $destination $script:InstallMarkerName), $marker, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($true)))

    Register-SenetechInstalledApp $destination
